knowledgeSources.description: Codebase AST dependency topology containing symbols, calls, imports, and community clusters. Must be queried during feature planning to determine ground-truth dependency chains.
Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) establishing state management, database schemas, invariants, and guardrail policies.
Obsidian architecture notes and visual canvas (graph.canvas) reflecting the extracted AST topology.

planningPolicy.instructions: When planning or implementing any feature, bugfix, or refactor, the agent must query .antigravity/graph.json to inspect real symbol nodes, caller references, and outbound dependency links before proposing changes.

goalPolicy.instructions: When a /goal queue is exhausted on a feature branch, open a Pull Request targeting main and trigger automated CodeRabbit review.
